nodes.label: Kits (product bundles, hero offer)
nodes.rationale: Kits express the complete-solution positioning better than single SKUs.

nodes.label: PriceConfig dollar rate (ARS pricing)
nodes.rationale: Prices computed in ARS from configurable dollar rate; store shows unavailable state when no rate is configured.

nodes.label: Projaska Store (product)
nodes.rationale: Online store for technology and security equipment; success = visitors find equipment fast, trust the store, and return.

nodes.label: Positioning: kits, advice, real stock, in-house installation
nodes.norm_label: positioning: kits, advice, real stock, in-house installation

nodes.label: Product Principles (trust before persuasion, pro + newcomer, kits hero, advice as product)
nodes.norm_label: product principles (trust before persuasion, pro + newcomer, kits hero, advice as product)

nodes.label: Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, Prisma/Neon, Vercel Blob
nodes.norm_label: stack: next.js 16, react 19, tailwind 4, prisma/neon, vercel blob

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (breaking-changes notice)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecations.

nodes.label: Projaska Brand Mark (blue crescent eye/lens logo)
nodes.norm_label: projaska brand mark (blue crescent eye/lens logo)

nodes.label: Admin panel (.admin)
nodes.rationale: Tokens, not rewrites: .admin remaps zinc scale to HUD grays, zeroes radii and removes shadows so existing zinc utilities get the look.

nodes.label: Channel Bar
nodes.rationale: Treats each category as a TV channel; filters via ?cat=, hosts accent-insensitive catalog search.

nodes.label: HUD Gray
nodes.rationale: Darker than the contract's #22272B on purpose, for more letterbox contrast.

nodes.label: OSD Dim
nodes.rationale: Set to #9aa2a8 so it holds at least 6:1 contrast on letterbox black.

nodes.label: The Viewfinder (Creative North Star)
nodes.rationale: Store seen through a camera viewfinder; persuasion comes from shown data (SKU, stock, price, rate) rather than soft heroes, icon tiles or shadowed cards.

nodes.label: Price as USD cost
nodes.rationale: Store computes peso sale price from the USD cost.

nodes.label: Single-frame cut motion
nodes.rationale: Motion behaves like a camera, not an app: no transitions; only the stepped REC blink and loading spinner animate.

nodes.label: Corner Brackets
nodes.rationale: Brackets mean selection or focus only; painted as background-image gradients so no extra DOM is needed; color inherited from one custom property.

nodes.label: The Lit Plate Rule
nodes.rationale: Supplier photos on white backgrounds merge into the plate via multiply.

nodes.label: Brand: Projaska, 'Tecnologia y Seguridad', blue lens logo
nodes.norm_label: brand: projaska, 'tecnologia y seguridad', blue lens logo
nodes.rationale: Existing blue circular lens/eye logo (~#147BBC) must be kept; direction is minimalist tech-and-security look replacing generic one.

nodes.label: Evidence on Hand (no testimonials, no contact channel yet)
nodes.norm_label: evidence on hand (no testimonials, no contact channel yet)
nodes.rationale: Do not invent testimonials/certifications; ask before showing a contact channel.

nodes.label: Prisma migration (Product.model + ProductSyncLog)
nodes.rationale: Must run before deploying code because the app reads the new column in every product query.

nodes.label: n8n sync workflow
nodes.rationale: 404 and 409 treated as warnings for manual review, not fatal errors.

nodes.label: POST /api/price-sync/update
nodes.rationale: Updates only changed fields; ambiguous sku/model match returns 409 without writing; equal prices with different decimals are not changes.

hyperedges.label: Price sync update flow (n8n -> auth -> validate -> update -> log)
